MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The smaller USB hub feels like a useful next purchase because it could connect the peripherals and USB Ethernet adapter I already use with my laptop.",
    "The surge protector fits my effort to organize my workspace, continuing the practical purpose of my cable covers, cable ties, and under-desk headphone holder."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "The Echo devices introduce voice-assistant uses I have not shown an interest in; buying computer accessories does not mean I want smart-home or in-car devices.",
    "The large storage drives do not address a storage need I have expressed, and my memory-card purchases do not establish a need for several terabytes.",
    "The HDMI cable fits my equipment, but I already have one and have no current reason to replace it or buy a longer cable. The USB-C cable similarly assumes a charging need my history does not establish."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "My interest in electronics seems to have been stretched into interest in almost any electronic device, even when it serves a different purpose.",
    "Buying cables and accessories seems to have been treated as a reason to offer more of them without considering whether they solve an additional problem."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "My latest purchases point toward connecting, organizing, and maintaining a computer workspace; products that help my existing equipment work together matter most right now.",
    "The scale of the accessory matters: a compact four-port hub meets the need I can identify, while ten ports add capacity I do not currently need."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "You recognized my interest in practical computer accessories, but often missed the specific workspace needs that make an accessory useful to me now."
}
